title: spec 15.3 wording: 'epoch increments on wrap or reboot' contradicts all-stack never-wrap epoch exhaustion (fail closed at 255)
description: Spec-text alignment bead (sweep part 3, R-06-342, docs/spec-coverage/06-security-part3.md). spec/06-security.md L1229-1230 says the link replay epoch is 'persisted to flash; increments on wrap or reboot'. All three implementations deliberately never wrap: C replay.h ('Epochs ... never wrap; epoch 0 after 255 is always rejected') + replay_persist.c TX-epoch reserve; Rust lichend.rs:211-236 (cold->128, 128-254->+1, 255->fail 'rotate the gateway identity', persist-fail->abort); Python epoch_store.py:48 (cold->128, EpochExhaustedError at 255). Wrapping would reopen the replay window, so implementations are STRICTER than the spec sentence; the spec text is the regression. Suggested fix: amend spec 15.3 to 'epoch increments on reboot; epoch space is never wrapped - exhaustion at 255 fails closed and requires identity rotation', matching epoch_rollover.json. Precedent: trickle Imax / GUARD_PPM align-spec-to-implementation decisions.
notes: Decision: amend spec. Epoch never wraps, exhaustion at 255 fails closed, requires identity rotation. Agent-implementable spec text fix.
